scope: The 23 school numbers in the 2025-26 Miami-Dade school-grades workbook not matched by raw public/charter CSV school number.
notes: This is a sourced reconciliation dataset, not an automatic production import.
Twenty-three unmatched school IDs do not mean twenty-three missing physical campuses.
Some county records have blank school numbers; others combine or co-locate distinct school divisions.
All school numbers are strings. Join using district plus four-digit school number, never name alone.
Academic percentages are achievement measures, not ordinal rankings.
School-published and directory conflicts are retained in each research finding.
Coordinates are intentionally unset in mapImport until physical address conflicts and campus identity are resolved.
Existing source CSVs and frontend data were not overwritten.
